qualifiers.text: * To be performed for nonsterile females of childbearing potential; only if not previously done as part of normal medical care during current hospitalization.

† Core temperature preferred; if core temperature not available, temperature must be obtained and recorded from two (2) non-core routes beginning with baseline assessment through four (4) hours; the route(s) of temperature measurement used immediately before randomization should be used immediately before dosing and for all temperature measurements during the Treatment Period.
‡ Laboratory data collected within 24 hours before dosing for Standard of Care evaluation may be used for Screening/Baseline Period laboratory values.

ֆ Laboratory data collected within the same calendar date for Standard of Care evaluation may be used for these assessments. If laboratory assessments are incomplete, missing assessments should be completed.
† To be collected immediately before IMP administration.
‡ To be collected at the end of IMP infusion.
